limitations: The original3.3s attempt rejects step866 after865 accepted states, all independently audited. The same-state retry also fails. Spatial diagnostics quantify strong contact-arithmetic sensitivity but do not establish its sole cause or a converged contact patch. Complete original history, physical spatial/contact/geometry tails, remaining model/feedback operating ranges and verified accuracy/cost remain incomplete. No force budget or physical parameter is relaxed. Only terminal cases are published. JSON files above200MB are preserved as exact ordered32MiB byte ranges, individually gzip-compressed, with original/part/stored SHA256 and offsets. Join decompressed ranges in index order to restore the original JSON exactly; no records are reduced or excluded. Runtime staging uses hard links for unchanged small originals.
